title: Privacy still switches on one click, now right beside the label
what_happens: 'Make it a Connect session' / 'Make anonymous' runs on one click with no confirmation (from code; not clicked). The explanation of what participants will be told is now only in the tooltip, so nothing on the way says what the switch changes.
who_hurts: Dane switching privacy by mistake changes what new participants are told (asked to opt in to being connected) with no second look.
suggested_fix: Ask first in a small Dialog that carries the explanation text (the same pattern ArchiveToggle now uses), which also solves F2 for privacy.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'text that explains what it does goes ... in the confirmation for an action that needs one'; Dane agreed earlier: 'Privacy ... switches with one click'
origin: earlier: privacy toggle before this PR
owners_call: Does switching privacy need a confirm, or is one click fine for an admin-only setting?
